bank.module: Session 8 — Analytical SQL: Window Functions, CTEs & Pivoting
bank.title: Session 8 — Pivot, Subquery Extensions & SQL Server Control Flow — Bank 002

questions.question: What characterizes a single-row subquery in Session 8?

options.text: It returns one value: one row and one column.
It must return every row from a table.
It can only be used with PIVOT.
It always returns a list for IN.

explanation.ar: الـ Single-Row Subquery بيرجع قيمة واحدة فقط، يعني row واحدة وcolumn واحدة.

questions.question: Which operators does Session 8 associate with multi-row subqueries?

explanation.ar: الـ Multi-Row Subquery بيرجع list، والمحاضرة بتربطه بـ `IN`, `ANY`, و`ALL`.

questions.question: What reliability note does Session 8 give when a subquery might return NULLs?

options.text: Always replace NOT IN with PIVOT.
Use RANK instead of any subquery.
Prefer NOT EXISTS instead of NOT IN.

explanation.ar: السلايد بيقول لو الـ subquery ممكن يرجع NULLs، الأفضل استخدام `NOT EXISTS` بدل `NOT IN` للموثوقية.

questions.question: A dashboard needs product categories to appear as separate report columns. Which taught transformation matches this need?

explanation.ar: PIVOT هدفه تحويل unique values من column إلى headers/columns، وده مناسب لتقارير cross-tab.

questions.question: A PIVOT report needs totals by category. Which component is required according to Session 8?

options.text: An aggregate such as SUM or AVG.

explanation.ar: من Core Components للـ PIVOT وجود aggregation زي SUM أو AVG، مع column to pivot وقائمة القيم.

questions.question: A monthly sales report must turn region values into columns and sum SalesAmount for each region. Which feature best fits?

explanation.ar: ده external-similar لنفس Pivot concept: regions تبقى headers والـ SalesAmount يتجمع بـ SUM.

questions.question: A SQL Server batch must execute one block when a Boolean condition is TRUE and another when it is FALSE. Which taught construct fits?

explanation.ar: `IF...ELSE` هو control-flow construct لتشغيل blocks مختلفة حسب Boolean condition.

questions.question: Inside a SELECT, you need to return "Expensive" or "Affordable" based on price. Which standard expression does Session 8 recommend?

explanation.ar: لإرجاع conditional value داخل SELECT، الـ standard والأوسع دعمًا هو `CASE`.

questions.question: For a simple binary true/false value in SQL Server 2012+, which shorthand function is shown?

explanation.ar: Session 8 بتعرض `IIF(Boolean_expression, value_if_true, value_if_false)` كـ shorthand لـ simple CASE.

questions.question: A stored batch may raise a runtime error and must move to an error-handling block. Which taught construct is designed for that?

options.text: BEGIN TRY...END TRY with BEGIN CATCH...END CATCH

explanation.ar: ده external-similar لنفس error-handling concept: TRY يراقب التنفيذ، ولو حصل runtime error ينتقل للـ CATCH.

questions.question: For salaries 3000, 5000, 7000, what rows satisfy `WHERE Salary > (SELECT AVG(Salary) FROM Staff)`?

explanation.ar: المتوسط = 5000، والشرط `>` مش `>=`، فـ 7000 بس هي اللي تعدي.

questions.question: A multi-row subquery returns values 2, 4, 6. Which outer value matches `IN (subquery)`?

explanation.ar: `IN` بيختبر العضوية في list الناتجة من الـ subquery؛ 4 موجودة ضمن 2,4,6.

questions.question: In the static PIVOT example, what becomes the pivoted column headers?

options.text: The listed Category values: Electronics, Furniture, and Clothing.
Every row number generated by ROW_NUMBER().

explanation.ar: الـ `FOR Category IN ([Electronics], [Furniture], [Clothing])` هو اللي بيحدد الـ headers الناتجة.

questions.question: A support-ticket report pivots `Status` with values Open, Closed, Pending. What becomes columns in the result?

explanation.ar: ده external-similar: القيم المحددة في IN للـ pivot column تتحول headers/columns في التقرير.

questions.question: When is Dynamic Pivot described as useful?

options.text: When there is only one fixed category forever.
When the column names are not known in advance.
Only when creating a primary key.

explanation.ar: Dynamic Pivot بيتستخدم لما أسماء الـ columns المطلوبة مش معروفة مسبقًا.

questions.question: Which set of tools does the Dynamic Pivot slide mention for building and executing the dynamic column list?

options.text: STUFF, FOR XML PATH, and sp_executesql

explanation.ar: السلايد بيذكر STUFF وFOR XML PATH لبناء column-list string، و`sp_executesql` للتنفيذ.

questions.question: Given `@mySalary = 5000` and `@avgSalary = 4000`, which IF...ELSE branch runs for `IF @mySalary > @avgSalary`?

options.text: The TRUE branch printing that the salary is above average.
Neither branch because IF cannot compare integers.

explanation.ar: 5000 > 4000 = TRUE، فالتنفيذ يدخل أول BEGIN...END block.

questions.question: If `@stock = 2` and the condition is `IF @stock > 5`, which branch should execute?

explanation.ar: ده external-similar: 2 > 5 = FALSE، فلو ELSE موجود هو اللي هيتنفذ.

questions.question: For `CASE WHEN price > 100 THEN 'Expensive' ELSE 'Affordable' END`, what category is returned when price = 150?

explanation.ar: 150 أكبر من 100، فـ CASE بيرجع result بتاع WHEN وهو `Expensive`.

questions.question: For `IIF(price > 100, 'Expensive', 'Affordable')`, what is returned when price = 80?

explanation.ar: 80 > 100 = FALSE، فـ IIF بيرجع القيمة التالتة `Affordable`.

questions.question: In the TRY...CATCH example, `SELECT 1 / @Denominator` runs with `@Denominator = 0`. What flow is taught?

options.text: A runtime error occurs and execution jumps from TRY to CATCH.
The division returns 0 and TRY continues normally.

explanation.ar: Divide-by-zero مثال مباشر على runtime error؛ لما يحصل جوه TRY التنفيذ ينتقل للـ CATCH.

questions.question: Inside a CATCH block, which taught function returns the error message text?

explanation.ar: Session 8 بتذكر `ERROR_MESSAGE()` ضمن diagnostic functions داخل CATCH.

questions.question: A transaction begins, a DML operation fails inside TRY, and `@@TRANCOUNT > 0` in CATCH. What action does the shown pattern take?

options.text: COMMIT TRANSACTION regardless of the error.

explanation.ar: الـ pattern في Slide 25 بيعمل rollback داخل CATCH لو لسه فيه active transaction، للحفاظ على integrity.

questions.question: An order update is wrapped in a transaction. If one statement raises an error, what matches the taught safety pattern?

options.text: Always commit even after the error.
Let CATCH roll back the active transaction instead of committing partial work.

explanation.ar: ده external-similar لنفس pattern: لو operation فشلت، CATCH يعمل ROLLBACK للـ active transaction بدل partial commit.

questions.question: Which statement does Session 8 describe as the preferred modern way to raise an exception?

explanation.ar: السلايد بيذكر `THROW` كـ preferred modern method، و`RAISERROR` كـ legacy method.

questions.question: A conditional label must be returned inside a SELECT query. Which taught feature is the appropriate in-query choice rather than procedural IF...ELSE?

options.text: CASE (or IIF for a simple binary condition).

explanation.ar: Session 8 بيفرق بين IF...ELSE للتحكم في flow وبين CASE/IIF لإرجاع conditional values داخل SELECT/UPDATE/WHERE.

questions.question: For a simple filter that fits naturally in a WHERE clause, which feature does the Summary slide recommend?

explanation.ar: الـ Summary بتقول: use Subqueries for simple filtering in WHERE clause.

questions.question: A complex reporting query has several joins and readability is becoming poor. Which approach follows the Session 8 summary?

options.text: Use PIVOT even if no cross-tab is needed.
Use IIF to hold entire result sets.
Use a CTE to organize the complex joins and improve code clarity.

explanation.ar: ده external-similar للـ best practice: CTEs مناسبة للـ complex joins وتحسين code clarity.

questions.question: When does the Summary slide recommend using PIVOT?

options.text: When the required output is a cross-tab reporting format.

explanation.ar: المحاضرة بتوصي باستخدام Pivot لما الـ output نفسه محتاج cross-tab format للتقرير.

questions.question: According to the Subquery vs CTE comparison, which feature supports recursion?

explanation.ar: الجدول في Slide 13 بيذكر إن CTE supports Recursive CTEs بينما subquery لا.

questions.question: A multi-row subquery returns salaries 3000, 5000, 7000. For an outer condition `salary > ALL (subquery)`, which salary value would satisfy it?

explanation.ar: `> ALL` لازم تكون أكبر من كل القيم الناتجة؛ أعلى قيمة 7000، فـ 8000 تحقق الشرط.

questions.question: Why can `NOT IN (subquery)` be risky when that subquery may include NULL according to Session 8?

options.text: NOT IN automatically deletes NULL rows from the table.
NOT IN can only be used with indexes.
The lecture explicitly recommends NOT EXISTS instead for better reliability when NULLs may appear.

explanation.ar: النقطة المطلوبة هنا مش تفاصيل خارج المنهج؛ السلايد نفسها بتقول استخدم NOT EXISTS بدل NOT IN لو NULLs محتملة عشان reliability.

source.reference: Slide 6 — NOT EXISTS vs NOT IN Note

questions.question: A PIVOT statement specifies the pivot column and IN list but omits an aggregate expression. What core component is missing?

options.text: The aggregation such as SUM(...) or AVG(...).

explanation.ar: PIVOT في المحاضرة له 3 core components، وأحدهم aggregation. من غيرها الـ design ناقص بالنسبة للـ syntax المعروض.

questions.question: A transaction performs several DML statements that must act as one safe unit and runtime errors are possible. Which taught design is best?

options.text: Commit before running the DML so errors are ignored.
BEGIN TRANSACTION, TRY the DML, COMMIT on success, and ROLLBACK in CATCH when needed.
Use PIVOT instead of a transaction.
Use RANK to decide whether errors matter.

explanation.ar: ده pattern Slide 25: transaction + TRY/CATCH، COMMIT لو نجح، وROLLBACK داخل CATCH عند الخطأ.

questions.question: You need to raise a new custom exception using the modern method shown in Session 8. Which should you choose?

options.text: RAISERROR as the preferred modern method.

explanation.ar: Session 8 بتسمي THROW الـ preferred modern method، بينما RAISERROR legacy.

questions.question: A report is simple: filter employees above the company average using one scalar result. Which approach best follows the lecture guidance?

options.text: Use NTILE to replace the average comparison.
Use a single-row subquery in the WHERE clause.

explanation.ar: المثال نفسه في Slide 5 بيستخدم single-row subquery للـ AVG، والـ Summary بيفضل subquery للـ simple WHERE filtering.

source.reference: Slides 5 and 26 — Single-Row Subquery and Best Practice

questions.question: An error occurs inside BEGIN TRY, but the code continues with statements later in the TRY block instead of going to CATCH. What contradicts the taught behavior?

options.text: Session 8 says execution should immediately jump to the associated CATCH block when an error occurs in TRY.
TRY is supposed to ignore every runtime error.

explanation.ar: الـ behavior المعروض واضح: runtime error جوه TRY ينقل التنفيذ فورًا للـ CATCH، فاستمرار باقي TRY يناقض الـ construct المشرح.

questions.question: A CASE expression is written inside SELECT without the closing keyword after the conditions. What is missing?

explanation.ar: Syntax الـ CASE في السلايد بينتهي بـ `END` قبل alias أو باقي SELECT.

questions.question: A developer uses IIF for a requirement with five different conditional outcomes and the logic becomes unreadable. What course-aligned correction is better?

options.text: Replace all conditions with CREATE INDEX.
Use PIVOT even though no row-to-column transformation is needed.
Use CASE with multiple WHEN branches for the multi-condition logic.
Use LAG for the five categories.

explanation.ar: IIF مناسب للـ binary true/false. لما الحالات متعددة، CASE أوضح ومصمم لـ multiple conditions.

questions.question: A reporting team hard-codes `[North], [South]` in a static PIVOT even though new region names appear unpredictably every month. What is the better taught fix?

options.text: Keep the fixed list forever and ignore new regions.
Use ROLLBACK to create new columns.
Use the Dynamic Pivot concept because the column names are not known in advance.

explanation.ar: ده external-similar troubleshooting مباشر: variable/unknown future headers هي الحالة اللي Dynamic Pivot معمول لها في Slide 18.
